title: Ultrasound-guided Injection for DeQuervain's
brief_summary: The investigators aim to perform a prospective study to evaluate the effectiveness of blind corticosteroid injections to US-guided injections for the treatment of de Quervain's disease. The results of the study will be used to validate current injection protocols or support the incorporation of ultrasonography to treat the disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pain with palpation at 1st dorsal compartment at wrist and positive Finkelstein's Test

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with evidence of osteoarthritis or degeneration of the wrist.
